MasulloGRH.finite_geometric_place_cutoffs.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  [(v : FinitePlace K) → MeasurableSpace (LocalField K v)ˣ] (μ : (v : FinitePlace K) → Measure (LocalField K v)ˣ)
  (φ : HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ) (T : ℝ) (hT : 1 < T)
  (hsupport :
    ∀ (v : FinitePlace K) (x : (LocalField K v)ˣ),
      φ (localClass K v x) ≠ 0 → T⁻¹ < normalizedLocalNorm K v ↑x ∧ normalizedLocalNorm K v ↑x < T)
  (hone : ∀ (v : FinitePlace K) (x : (LocalField K v)ˣ), normalizedLocalNorm K v ↑x = 1 → φ (localClass K v x) = 0)
  (hintegrable :
    ∀ (v : FinitePlace K), ↑(Ideal.absNorm v.asIdeal) ≤ T → Integrable (localGeometricIntegrand K v φ) (μ v)) :
  (∀ (S : Finset (FinitePlace K)),
      smallNormPlaces K T ⊆ S →
        ∑ v ∈ S, finiteLocalGeometricTerm K μ φ v = ∑' (v : FinitePlace K), finiteLocalGeometricTerm K μ φ v) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun S => ∑ v ∈ S, finiteLocalGeometricTerm K μ φ v) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (∑' (v : FinitePlace K), finiteLocalGeometricTerm K μ φ v))
